title: L'acqua bolle a 100 °C
code:
from CoolProp.CoolProp import PropsSI
T = PropsSI("T", "P", 101325, "Q", 0, "Water")
print(round(T - 273.15, 1))
codeHtml: from CoolProp.CoolProp import PropsSI T = PropsSI("T", "P", 101325, "Q", 0, "Water") print(round(T - 273.15, 1))
explain: CoolProp lavora in unità SI: kelvin e pascal. A 101 325 Pa il liquido saturo (Q = 0) è a 373,12 K, cioè circa 100,0 °C.
